title.narrative: In 2024 Brazil made remarkable strides in public health, recovering vaccination coverages and strengthening quality primary care services, with UNICEF’s contributions through advocacy and technical assistance to 2,023 municipalities engaged in UNICEF Seal initiative; 07 capital cities engaged in the Early Childhood Friendly Facilities initiative; and in response to emergencies at the border of Brazil and Venezuela, in the Amazon Region and during the floods in Rio Grande do Sul. These efforts culminated in Brazil’s recertification as a measles-free country and UNICEF being awarded, by President Lula, the Oswaldo Cruz Medal of Honor, the major recognition of public health contribution provided by Ministry of Health. ;
